scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@url-shortener/domain && npm run build --workspace=@url-shortener/application && npm run build --workspace=@url-shortener/db && npm run build --workspace=@url-shortener/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@url-shortener/observability
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace=@url-shortener/web && npm run build --workspace=@url-shortener/api && npm run build --workspace=@url-shortener/worker
scripts.build:all: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.generate:contracts: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@url-shortener/api && node apps/api/dist/openapi/generate-openapi.js && openapi-typescript packages/contracts/openapi.json -o packages/contracts/src/generated/api-types.ts
scripts.check: npm run verify:toolchain && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:architecture && npm run build && npm run verify:contracts && npm run verify:migrations
